authority: #K2-412 sec.4.3: the deterministic implementation + same-class regression (RED then GREEN) that pins 'port reachability' as a regression-testable semantic. Carries #K2-411 sec.2 D1; #K2-412 sec.5: the means switch = drawing-layer port reachability / in-domain re-route.

what_changed.change: the snap relaxation is extended from PORT points to the ENDPOINT-OWN-CELL (D1): when the plain snap (which demands a FREE, in-island cell) prunes the endpoint cell, the wrapper now returns the nearest cell whose grid point still lies on the net's OWN copper -- evaluated IGNORING the prune mask for that cell ONLY.
what_changed.readout: the per-edge precheck now records endpoint_own_cell_hits (how often D1 fired) and the artifact carries the D1 rule verbatim.

why_this_is_the_observed_wall.symptom: R1150: the maze refuses all eight endpoints with no-free-start/goal-node; the eight are DROP-NAMED and C1 stays 8 (C2 clean).
why_this_is_the_observed_wall.mechanism: every maze edge endpoint lies ON the net's own copper (the anchors are pad/via/track centres of the SAME island), so its own cell is by definition a legal start/goal; the plain snap prunes that cell whenever a foreign obstacle sits within (clearance + half-width + margin) of the cell point. That is exactly the 'the drawing never defines a reachable in-domain path' root cause recorded in R1154.
why_this_is_the_observed_wall.corroboration: the saved pass-2 ledger (attempt4 work dir) names the four still-blocked edges as no-free-start-node x3 / no-free-goal-node x1.

determinism: bounded to (2*maxr+1)^2 cells, ordered by (radius, di, dj); maxr = 4 (coarse) / 6 (fine); NO random, NO parameter sweep, NO iterative search, NO board change.
safety_guards_unchanged: C35: the relaxation re-imposes the domain wall EXPLICITLY -- a start/goal cell may never be outside the declared bound-rect, even though the prune mask is ignored for that one cell.
every emitted leg is still adjudicated by seg_exact / via_exact (same clearance model; this wrapper already raises the floor to 0.20 mm).
the FINAL DRC still adjudicates; DROP-NAMED (#K2-411 sec.2) is preserved -- a gap the maze still cannot route stays NAMED, never a silent direct stitch.
not a criteria change: no rule, SPEC, manifest or frozen source is touched.

red_green.red: before the fix: mr.snap_node(...) over a pruned-but-own-copper endpoint returned None (AssertionError: unexpectedly None).
red_green.green: after the fix: it returns the net's own copper cell; the two negative controls hold -- a foreign point is never relaxed, and a cell outside the C35 wall is never returned.

not_yet_measured: C1 is NOT re-measured in this window (no N=1 quota is pre-authorized by #K2-412 sec.4). This window delivers ONLY the deterministic enabler + its regression + the standing reasonableness row.
next: request N=1 (the A^5 re-run with the endpoint-own-cell relaxation active) per #K2-412 sec.4.4; any gap the maze still refuses stays DROP-NAMED and routes to the deviation channel.
